'''Tando''' is one of the [[White Tower]] [[Younglings]].

== Appearance ==
He is a young [[Andoran]].

== Activities ==
He is one of the Younglings now stationed in [[Dorlan]]. He reports to [[Gawyn Trakand]] about [[Katerine Alruddin]]'s sudden appearance in Dorlan.
